digest.component_or_area: advisory and ref lock modules in reconciler engine
propositions: Bridge preview lock test fails with ModuleNotFoundError when _advisory_lock and _ref_lock attempt unconditional top-level import of rebar_reconciler package in standalone-loaded context where package is intentionally absent

Commit d9e0f0e733 introduced unconditional from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter at two locations, breaking the supported by-path standalone execution contract documented in _advisory_lock.py:36-52 and _loader.py:1-34

Both _advisory_lock.py:83 and _ref_lock.py:194 must use lazy_load with dotted key rebar_reconciler.git_adapter to converge on the same sys.modules entry as unchanged package-context importers and restore standalone execution
Repairing only _advisory_lock leaves latent identical failure in _ref_lock._git seam, confirmed by sequential runtime failure progression during troubleshooting
